items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Lester Young Johnson said, 'listen, we've got to get this thing straightened out.' ... 'Baby, we're going to call you Sir Charles, you know. And that's where I got the name.'

ctx.x: So nobody knew who it was, and of course I for some reason or another got most of the calls, and so Lester Young Johnson said, 'listen, we've got to get this thing straightened out.' He said, 'listen, my man said you look like
royalty any way, you should have a name so we can identify you he said. Baby, we're going to call you Sir Charles, you know. And that's where I got the name.
